  bash apply-step367-overlay.sh /home/promano/GitHub/slack-update

  cd /home/promano/GitHub/slack-update
  STEP=phase-1-readme-roadmap-reconciliation
  bash "tests/reference/test-$STEP-harness.sh"

  git add -- \
    CHANGELOG.md \
    README.md \
    "docs/reference/$STEP.md" \
    "tools/reference/$STEP.py" \
    "tests/reference/test-$STEP-harness.sh" \
    tests/fixtures/reference/acceptance/phase-1/"$STEP"-{confirmed366,policy,reconciliation,step366-user-acceptance}.json

  git diff --cached --check
  git commit -m "Phase 1 step 367: reconcile README and Phase 1 roadmap"
  git push origin main
  git status --short
  git log -1 --oneline
  git log -1 --oneline origin/main
)
